name: Vanillite
author: hthoene@users.noreply.github.com
description: Vanillite: a Minecraft Java Edition server written in Rust that behaves like Vanilla in game; fast, multithreaded and low on RAM. Every server.properties and vanillite.toml setting is a variable. https://github.com/hthoene/Vanillite

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Vanillite needs no installation: the image holds the server, and the first start downloads
# Mojang's server jar for the Vanilla data into cache/.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Nothing to install."

variables.name: Accept the Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Set to true to accept the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA). The server does not start before. The panel's EULA prompt writes eula.txt instead.

variables.name: Profile
variables.description: Preset of every vanillite.toml rule: vanilla (Vanilla behaviour), technical (Vanilla plus what technical players need), paper or spigot (their defaults). Rules set below or in vanillite.toml override the profile.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Console log level: error, warn, info, debug or trace.

variables.name: Accepts Transfers
variables.description: Accept transfers of players from other servers. server.properties: accepts-transfers.

variables.name: Allow Flight
variables.description: Allow flight in survival (otherwise flying players are kicked). server.properties: allow-flight.

variables.name: Broadcast Console To Ops
variables.description: Send console command output to operators. server.properties: broadcast-console-to-ops.

variables.name: Broadcast RCON To Ops
variables.description: Send RCON command output to operators. server.properties: broadcast-rcon-to-ops.

variables.name: Chat Spam Threshold Seconds
variables.description: Seconds of chat spam (each message counts one second, each tick takes 1/20 away) after which non-operators are kicked; 0 disables. server.properties: chat-spam-threshold-seconds.

variables.name: Command Spam Threshold Seconds
variables.description: Like `chat-spam-threshold-seconds`, for commands. server.properties: command-spam-threshold-seconds.

variables.name: Bug Report Link
variables.description: Link shown as "report bug" in the client. server.properties: bug-report-link. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: Difficulty of new worlds. server.properties: difficulty.

variables.name: Enable Code Of Conduct
variables.description: Show the code of conduct to joining players. server.properties: enable-code-of-conduct.

variables.name: Enable Query
variables.description: Enable the GameSpy4 query listener. server.properties: enable-query.

variables.name: Enable RCON
variables.description: Enable remote console access. server.properties: enable-rcon.

variables.name: Enable Status
variables.description: Answer server list pings. server.properties: enable-status.

variables.name: Enforce Secure Profile
variables.description: Require chat signing keys from Mojang. server.properties: enforce-secure-profile.

variables.name: Enforce Whitelist
variables.description: Kick players not on the whitelist when it is reloaded. server.properties: enforce-whitelist.

variables.name: Entity Broadcast Range Percentage
variables.description: Entity tracking range in percent of the default. Range: 10 to 1000. server.properties: entity-broadcast-range-percentage.

variables.name: Force Gamemode
variables.description: Force players into the default game mode on join. server.properties: force-gamemode.

variables.name: Function Permission Level
variables.description: Permission level of functions. Range: 1 to 4. server.properties: function-permission-level.

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: Default game mode. server.properties: gamemode.

variables.name: Generate Structures
variables.description: Generate structures in new chunks. server.properties: generate-structures.

variables.name: Generator Settings
variables.description: Settings of the flat and customised generators (JSON). server.properties: generator-settings. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Hardcore
variables.description: Hardcore mode. server.properties: hardcore.

variables.name: Hide Online Players
variables.description: Hide the player sample in the server list. server.properties: hide-online-players.

variables.name: Initial Disabled Packs
variables.description: Data packs disabled when the world is created. server.properties: initial-disabled-packs. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Initial Enabled Packs
variables.description: Data packs enabled when the world is created. server.properties: initial-enabled-packs. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Level Name
variables.description: World folder name. server.properties: level-name. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Level Seed
variables.description: World seed; empty = random. server.properties: level-seed. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Level Type
variables.description: World preset of new worlds. server.properties: level-type. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Log IPs
variables.description: Log client IP addresses. server.properties: log-ips.

variables.name: Max Chained Neighbor Updates
variables.description: Maximum chained neighbour updates before skipping. server.properties: max-chained-neighbor-updates.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players. server.properties: max-players.

variables.name: Max Tick Time
variables.description: Milliseconds a single tick may take before the watchdog stops the server; -1 disables. server.properties: max-tick-time.

variables.name: Max World Size
variables.description: Maximum world border radius. Range: 1 to 29999984. server.properties: max-world-size.

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Message of the day in the server list. server.properties: motd. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Network Compression Threshold
variables.description: Packets larger than this many bytes are compressed; -1 disables compression. server.properties: network-compression-threshold.

variables.name: Online Mode
variables.description: Authenticate players with Mojang. server.properties: online-mode.

variables.name: Op Permission Level
variables.description: Permission level of operators. Range: 0 to 4. server.properties: op-permission-level.

variables.name: Pause When Empty Seconds
variables.description: Seconds without players after which the server stops ticking; 0 disables. server.properties: pause-when-empty-seconds.

variables.name: Player Idle Timeout
variables.description: Minutes of inactivity before a player is kicked; 0 disables. server.properties: player-idle-timeout.

variables.name: Prevent Proxy Connections
variables.description: Kick players whose IP differs from the one Mojang saw. server.properties: prevent-proxy-connections.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Port of the query listener. Range: 1 to 65535. server.properties: query.port.

variables.name: Rate Limit
variables.description: Maximum packets per second before a player is kicked; 0 disables. server.properties: rate-limit.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: RCON password. server.properties: rcon.password. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: RCON port. Range: 1 to 65535. server.properties: rcon.port.

variables.name: Region File Compression
variables.description: Compression of chunks in region files. server.properties: region-file-compression.

variables.name: Require Resource Pack
variables.description: Kick players who decline the resource pack. server.properties: require-resource-pack.

variables.name: Resource Pack
variables.description: Resource pack URL. server.properties: resource-pack. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Resource Pack ID
variables.description: Resource pack UUID. server.properties: resource-pack-id. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Resource Pack Prompt
variables.description: Resource pack prompt (text component). server.properties: resource-pack-prompt. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Resource Pack SHA-1
variables.description: Resource pack SHA-1. server.properties: resource-pack-sha1. Empty: the value in server.properties.

variables.name: Simulation Distance
variables.description: Simulation distance in chunks. Range: 2 to 32. server.properties: simulation-distance.

variables.name: Spawn Protection
variables.description: Radius around the spawn only operators may build in. server.properties: spawn-protection.

variables.name: Status Heartbeat Interval
variables.description: Seconds between status heartbeats to the management server; 0 disables. server.properties: status-heartbeat-interval.

variables.name: Sync Chunk Writes
variables.description: Flush region files synchronously. server.properties: sync-chunk-writes.

variables.name: View Distance
variables.description: View distance in chunks. Range: 2 to 32. server.properties: view-distance.

variables.name: White List
variables.description: Only whitelisted players may join. server.properties: white-list.

variables.name: Tick: Parallel Dimensions
variables.description: Dimensions tick in parallel, each on its own thread (decision D2). Cross-dimension effects then apply at the end of the tick instead of immediately: an entity entering a portal from the overworld arrives one tick later, `execute in` other dimensions runs at the end of the tick. `false` gives exact Vanilla order. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: performance.tick.parallel-dimensions.

variables.name: Threads: Compute
variables.description: Worker threads of the compute pool (world generation, lighting, saving, parallel tick phases). 0 = number of cores minus the busy tick threads, at least 1. Range: 0 to 1024. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.threads.compute.

variables.name: Autosave: Interval
variables.description: Ticks between autosaves. Vanilla saves every 5 minutes of game time. Range: 20 to 1728000. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.autosave.interval.

variables.name: Storage: Layout
variables.description: Folder layout of the dimensions: `"vanilla"` keeps every dimension in `<level>/dimensions/` like Vanilla and Paper; `"spigot"` puts the nether into `<level>_nether/` and the end into `<level>_the_end/` like Spigot and CraftBukkit, so the world can be opened by Spigot without conversion. A world found in the other layout is moved into this one once at startup. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: storage.layout.

variables.name: Backup: Interval
variables.description: Minutes between backups; disabled makes none. The first one is made one interval after the start. Range: 1 to 525600. Also accepts disabled. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: disabled). vanillite.toml: backup.interval.

variables.name: Backup: Keep
variables.description: Backups kept; older ones are deleted after a new one is complete. 0 keeps all. Range: 0 to 10000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 10). vanillite.toml: backup.keep.

variables.name: Backup: Directory
variables.description: Folder of the archives, relative to the server folder. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: backups). vanillite.toml: backup.directory.

variables.name: Backup: Compression Level
variables.description: Deflate level of the archives, 1 (fast) to 9 (small); 0 stores without compression. Region files are compressed already, so higher levels gain little. Range: 0 to 9. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1). vanillite.toml: backup.compression-level.

variables.name: Watchdog: Early Warning After
variables.description: Seconds without a finished tick after which a first warning is logged. Range: 1 to 3600. Also accepts disabled. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 10). vanillite.toml: watchdog.early-warning-after.

variables.name: Watchdog: Warning Interval
variables.description: Seconds between further warnings while the server hangs. Range: 1 to 3600. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 5). vanillite.toml: watchdog.warning-interval.

variables.name: Security: Max Joins Per Tick
variables.description: Logins accepted into the game per tick. Protects the tick from join floods. Range: 1 to 1000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 5). vanillite.toml: security.max-joins-per-tick.

variables.name: Commands: Max Command Length
variables.description: Longest command line that is parsed (Vanilla: the packet's 32767 characters). Range: 16 to 32767. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 32767). vanillite.toml: commands.max-command-length.

variables.name: Commands: Max Suggestion Input
variables.description: Longest tab completion input; longer requests get no suggestions (Vanilla accepts 32500 characters). Range: 16 to 32500. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 2048). vanillite.toml: commands.max-suggestion-input.

variables.name: Commands: Max Suggestions
variables.description: Suggestions per answer. Range: 1 to 10000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1000). vanillite.toml: commands.max-suggestions.

variables.name: Commands: Max Message Length
variables.description: Characters of a message argument (`say`, `msg`, `kick`). Range: 16 to 32767. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 256). vanillite.toml: commands.max-message-length.

variables.name: Commands: Max NBT Depth
variables.description: Nesting depth of SNBT in arguments. Range: 1 to 512. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 512). vanillite.toml: commands.max-nbt-depth.

variables.name: Commands: Max NBT Path Nodes
variables.description: Nodes of an NBT path. Range: 1 to 4096. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 256). vanillite.toml: commands.max-nbt-path-nodes.

variables.name: Commands: Max Selector Options
variables.description: Options inside one entity selector `[...]`. Range: 1 to 1024. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 64). vanillite.toml: commands.max-selector-options.

variables.name: Commands: Max Message Selectors
variables.description: Entity selectors inside one message argument. Range: 0 to 256. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 16). vanillite.toml: commands.max-message-selectors.

variables.name: Commands: Max Redirect Depth
variables.description: Nested redirects followed while parsing one command. Range: 1 to 1024. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 64). vanillite.toml: commands.max-redirect-depth.

variables.name: Survival: Time Sync Interval
variables.description: Ticks between the game time packets every player gets (Vanilla: every second). Clients run the clocks themselves in between; a longer interval saves traffic with many players, the game time on the client may then lag behind a little. Range: 1 to 1200. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 20). vanillite.toml: performance.survival.time-sync-interval.

variables.name: Proxy: Velocity Secret
variables.description: Shared secret of modern forwarding (the proxy's `forwarding.secret`). Empty turns forwarding off. With a secret, players' identities and addresses come from the proxy, signed with it; `online-mode` then only applies to direct connections. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: ). vanillite.toml: proxy.velocity-secret.

variables.name: Proxy: Allow Direct Connections
variables.description: With forwarding on, also accept players who connect directly instead of through the proxy (authenticated as usual). Off: they are refused. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: false). vanillite.toml: proxy.allow-direct-connections.

variables.name: Multiversion: Versions
variables.description: Older versions whose clients may join: `"all"` (every version this build translates, currently the previous release), `"none"`, or a comma-separated list of version names such as `"26.2"`. Clients of the server's own version are not translated and pay nothing. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: all). vanillite.toml: multiversion.versions.

variables.name: Plugins: Enabled
variables.description: Load the plugins in `plugins/`. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: plugins.enabled.

variables.name: Plugins: Safe Mode After Crash
variables.description: After a crash inside a plugin's code (a fatal signal or a watchdog kill), skip that plugin at the next starts until its library changes or `plugins/.crashed` is removed, so a supervisor (Docker, systemd) brings the server back. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: plugins.safe-mode-after-crash.

variables.name: Plugins: Development
variables.description: Development: the console command `vanillite plugin reload <id>` loads a new build of a plugin at runtime and moves its state. Old builds stay in memory. Not for production servers. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: false). vanillite.toml: plugins.development.

variables.name: Plugins: Pins
variables.description: Pinned SHA-256 hashes of plugin libraries, `id=hex,id=hex`. A plugin whose library has another hash is refused. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: ). vanillite.toml: plugins.pins.

variables.name: Bedrock: Enabled
variables.description: Accept Bedrock players. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: false). vanillite.toml: bedrock.enabled.

variables.name: Bedrock: Port
variables.description: UDP port. Bedrock's default is 19132. Range: 1 to 65535. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 19132). vanillite.toml: bedrock.port.

variables.name: Bedrock: Online Mode
variables.description: Require an Xbox Live login. Off accepts any identity a client claims: only for tests on closed networks. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: bedrock.online-mode.

variables.name: Bedrock: Name Prefix
variables.description: Prefix of Bedrock players' Java names, so they never collide with Java accounts. Bedrock players get the UUID `00000000-0000-0000-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx` of their XUID (like Floodgate); whitelist and operators use that UUID. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: .). vanillite.toml: bedrock.name-prefix.

variables.name: Bedrock: Max Connections Per Ip
variables.description: Bedrock connections per IP address. Range: 1 to 1000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 8). vanillite.toml: bedrock.max-connections-per-ip.

variables.name: Bedrock: Max Packets Per Second
variables.description: Packets per second a Bedrock client may send before it is kicked. Range: 50 to 100000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1000). vanillite.toml: bedrock.max-packets-per-second.

variables.name: Bedrock: Max View Distance
variables.description: Largest chunk radius granted to Bedrock clients. Range: 2 to 32. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 12). vanillite.toml: bedrock.max-view-distance.

variables.name: Bedrock: Chunk Cache Sections
variables.description: Translated chunk sections kept for all Bedrock players (each section is translated once for every viewer). About 4 KiB each. Range: 0 to 1048576. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 16384). vanillite.toml: bedrock.chunk-cache-sections.

variables.name: Bedrock: Threads
variables.description: Threads of the Bedrock frontend. Range: 1 to 64. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 2). vanillite.toml: bedrock.threads.

variables.name: Chat: Max Pending Messages
variables.description: Signed messages a player may have received without acknowledging them before it is kicked (`too_many_pending_chats`). Range: 64 to 65536. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 4096). vanillite.toml: chat.max-pending-messages.

variables.name: Exploits: TNT Duplication
variables.description: TNT can be duplicated with pistons and slime or honey blocks. Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.tnt-duplication.

variables.name: Exploits: Carpet Duplication
variables.description: Carpets can be duplicated with pistons. Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.carpet-duplication.

variables.name: Exploits: Rail Duplication
variables.description: Rails can be duplicated with pistons. Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.rail-duplication.

variables.name: Exploits: Headless Pistons
variables.description: Pistons without a head can be created. Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.headless-pistons.

variables.name: Exploits: Break Unbreakable Blocks
variables.description: Bedrock and end portal frames can be broken with pistons and explosions. Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.break-unbreakable-blocks.

variables.name: Exploits: Gravity Block Duplication
variables.description: Falling blocks can be duplicated through end portals. Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.gravity-block-duplication.

variables.name: Exploits: String Duplication
variables.description: String can be duplicated with tripwire mechanics. Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.string-duplication.

variables.name: Exploits: Invulnerable End Crystals
variables.description: End crystals can be made invulnerable. Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.invulnerable-end-crystals.

variables.name: Distances: View Distance
variables.description: View distance in chunks; "vanilla" uses `view-distance` of server.properties. Applies to every world. Range: 2 to 32. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.distances.view-distance.

variables.name: Distances: Simulation Distance
variables.description: Simulation distance in chunks; "vanilla" uses `simulation-distance` of server.properties. Applies to every world. Range: 2 to 32. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.distances.simulation-distance.

variables.name: Entity Tracking: Player Range
variables.description: Tracking range of players. Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 512. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.player-range.

variables.name: Entity Tracking: Animal Range
variables.description: Tracking range of animals, ambient and water mobs. Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 512. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.animal-range.

variables.name: Entity Tracking: Monster Range
variables.description: Tracking range of monsters. Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 512. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.monster-range.

variables.name: Entity Tracking: Misc Range
variables.description: Tracking range of everything else (items, projectiles, vehicles, decorations). Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 512. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.misc-range.

variables.name: Entity Tracking: Overload Tick Millis
variables.description: Overload protection: while a world tick takes longer than this many milliseconds (smoothed), movement updates of tracked entities (position, rotation, head) are sent less often, up to `overload-max-interval-scale` times their Vanilla interval, and back at the Vanilla rate once ticks are fast again. Spawns, removals and entity data are never delayed. "disabled" keeps Vanilla's intervals: an overloaded server then slows down like Vanilla. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 1000. Also accepts disabled. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: disabled). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.overload-tick-millis.

variables.name: Entity Tracking: Overload Max Interval Scale
variables.description: Largest factor on the movement update interval under overload. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 20. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 4). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.overload-max-interval-scale.

variables.name: Movement: Too Fast Check
variables.description: Players that move faster than Vanilla allows are teleported back ("moved too quickly"). Vanilla's `playerMovementCheck` game rule. Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: movement.too-fast-check.

variables.name: Movement: Elytra Too Fast Check
variables.description: The "moved too quickly" check also applies while gliding with an elytra. Vanilla's `elytraMovementCheck` game rule. Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: movement.elytra-too-fast-check.

variables.name: Movement: Wrong Movement Check
variables.description: Players whose movement does not match the server's collision result are teleported back ("moved wrongly"). Not enforced yet: it needs block collision (milestone 3). Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: movement.wrong-movement-check.

variables.name: Movement: Flying Kick
variables.description: Players floating in the air longer than Vanilla allows are kicked unless `allow-flight` is on. Not enforced yet: it needs block collision (milestone 3). Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: movement.flying-kick.

variables.name: Chunks: Unload Delay
variables.description: Ticks a chunk stays loaded after no player or ticket needs it, so walking back does not load it again. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 6000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 100). vanillite.toml: performance.chunks.unload-delay.

variables.name: Chunks: Max Jobs
variables.description: Background chunk jobs (loads, generation steps, light) in flight per world. Higher values load faster with many players at the cost of memory for queued work. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 4096. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 64). vanillite.toml: performance.chunks.max-jobs.

variables.name: Simulation: Max Block Ticks
variables.description: Scheduled block ticks run per tick. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 1000000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 65536). vanillite.toml: performance.simulation.max-block-ticks.

variables.name: Simulation: Max Fluid Ticks
variables.description: Scheduled fluid ticks run per tick. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 1000000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 65536). vanillite.toml: performance.simulation.max-fluid-ticks.

variables.name: Simulation: Max Chained Neighbor Updates
variables.description: Chained neighbour and shape updates of one block change before the rest is skipped; "vanilla" uses `max-chained-neighbor-updates` of server.properties. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 100000000. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.simulation.max-chained-neighbor-updates.

variables.name: Simulation: Max Relights Per Tick
variables.description: Chunks whose light is recomputed per tick after block changes, each as one background job over its 5 × 5 area. Lower values spread bursts over more ticks. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 65536. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1024). vanillite.toml: performance.simulation.max-relights-per-tick.

variables.name: Collisions: Max Entity Collisions
variables.description: Entity collisions processed per entity and tick. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1024. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.collisions.max-entity-collisions.

variables.name: Mobs: Path Nodes Per Tick
variables.description: Path finding nodes all mobs of the world may visit per tick; searches over the budget fail and are retried later. 0 = unlimited (Vanilla). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 10000000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.mobs.path-nodes-per-tick.

variables.name: Mobs: Activation Range
variables.description: Mobs farther than this many blocks from every player tick only every 20th tick (activation range). 0 = off (Vanilla: every mob in simulation distance ticks). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 512. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.mobs.activation-range.

variables.name: Items: Despawn Ticks
variables.description: Ticks an item lies on the ground before it despawns. Lower values keep fewer item entities around on busy servers. Applies to every world. Range: 20 to 32766. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 6000). vanillite.toml: performance.items.despawn-ticks.
